lines.text: Many learners say: I came here for study English.
Better: I came here to study English.
Before a verb, use to. Not for.
To! I went out to buy milk.

data.wrong: I came here for study English.
data.right: I came here to study English.
data.why: Before a verb, use to. Not for.

native.tip: 表示目的时，to 后面接动词原形，不用 for + 动词。

en.tip: To give a purpose, use “to” plus a verb, not “for” plus a verb.
en.caption: Do you say “I came here for study English.”? 😅 To give a purpose, use to plus the base verb: “I came here to study English.”. Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
